title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Accounts Note: Payments, Fleet Discounts and Write-Offs on Calibration Orders
content:
Payments and write-offs on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order are booked against the order and reduce what is owed on it.

## Payments

A customer pays a customer-pay order's balance on completion by one of the tier's accepted payment methods — this clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis on which a customer-pay order is paid. A glass program pays its order under its own remittance reference.

## Write-offs

- A fleet account's calibration charge is reduced by a fleet discount write-off of the tier's fleet discount percentage, rounded to the cent.
- Write-offs name the charge they reduce and never exceed it.
- A billing error write-off corrects a wrong charge.
- Goodwill is capped at the tier's goodwill credit authority per order, measured against the goodwill already written off on the order, beyond which the request is declined — this clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for goodwill on calibration orders.

## Terms used on the order's money history

- **Balance of the order:** the order's charges less its transfers onto an insurance claim repair order, its payments and its write-offs, over the life of the order.
- **Goodwill written off on the order:** the total of the order's goodwill write-offs over the life of the order.

Charges raise the balance; transfers onto an insurance claim repair order, payments and no-charge write-offs lower it.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A fleet account's calibration charge is 449.00 USD and the fleet discount percentage is 5. The fleet discount write-off is 5 percent of 449.00, that is 22.45 USD, and it names the 449.00 calibration charge as the charge it reduces. The balance after the write-off is 426.55 USD.

## Points of judgement

- A write-off of 500.00 USD against a charge of 449.00 USD would exceed the charge it names; a write-off never does.
- A glass program's payment carries the program's own remittance reference.
